recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a curl ping to Healthchecks.io at the end of nightly-sync, set to expect one ping every 24h and to alert the user when a ping is missed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know by morning if nightly-sync failed, without reading logs. Nothing in that requires a central log or Docker.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology and moving everything to Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The job only emails on success, so a startup crash sends nothing and silence looks like success.
labels.Checked myself: Per your note: cron at 03:00 on edna, email only on finish, 4 nights of startup token crash with no email, no other alert.

note: The reply recommends one hosted dead-man's-switch alert, explicitly rejects the central log and Docker, and puts all four labelled lines, each grounded in this case, before the recommendation.
